issues.description: Lecture constructor visibility differs from what students are likely to expect: the reference solution defines the constructor without an access modifier (package-private), while the exercise instructs students to create and use a constructor (e.g., from Main) to instantiate Lecture objects. If student code or automated tests instantiate Lecture from a different package, the package-private constructor would be inaccessible.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the constructor explicitly public in the reference solution (and align expectations for students): `public Lecture(String lectureName, int numberOfInscribedStudents, int numberOfGuestStudents, int numberOfLecturers, int numberOfTutors) { ... }`.
